name: Eaton MTL GECMA IS Tablet PC
summary: The Eaton MTL GECMA IS Tablet PC is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) 10.1-inch Windows tablet from Eaton, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Windows 11 IoT Enterprise.
imageAlt: Eaton MTL GECMA IS Tablet PC, front view

atex.marking: II 1GD Ex ia IIC T4 Ga / II 1GD Ex ia IIIC T135°C Da
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2026-05-26), checked 2026-10-25. ATEX number from the manual.

iecex.marking: Ex ia IIC T4 Ga / Ex ia IIIC T135°C Da

certification.northAmerica: UL certificate CER230869: Class I Div 1 Groups C, D T4; Class I Zone 0 AEx ia IIB T4 Ga (US) / Ex ia IIB T4 Ga (CAN); UL 913 8th ed. Class I, II, III Div 1. Gas group is IIB in North America, IIC in Europe/IECEx.
certification.zone0Note: Zone 0 rated only inside the case supplied by the maker.

safety.conditions: Do not remove or replace the battery pack in hazardous areas; use only battery AAEB-100-XX and charge it only on the tablet; charge only with Eaton charger GEC-ATP-POAD-x-01; do not open the SIM/SD port in a hazardous location; in Zone 0 use only inside Eaton case GEC-ATP-CC-01 (friction hazard); avoid friction on the enclosure; inspect for damage; service only by Eaton; do not charge, connect or disconnect in hazardous areas; no accessories or extensions in hazardous areas (IECEx NMK 25.0029X conditions a-j). Um = 20 V appears in the ATEX/UL marking printed in the instruction manual, not in the IECEx text.
safety.peripherals: No accessories or extensions in the hazardous area; SIM/microSD slots not to be opened; docking connector and charging only in safe areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Eaton accessory list: carry case GEC-ATP-CC-01 (required in Zone 0), anti-glare screen protector GEC-ATP-AGSP-01, USB cables GEC-ATP-STUSBS-01, IS USB adapter GEC-ATP-ISUSB-01, shoulder strap GEC-ATP-SHST-01, stylus with tether GEC-ATP-STYT-01, docking station GEC-ATP-DOST-01 (safe area), hands-free harness GEC-ATP-HFHA-01, power adapter GEC-ATP-POAD-XX-01. Ex-area use of each accessory is not stated beyond the case, strap and stylus.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 11 IoT Enterprise (channel/LTSC year not stated; Eaton: 'Windows 11 IoT')

specs.chip: Intel quad-core Atom (Apollo Lake) 1.6 GHz base, 1.8 GHz burst
specs.camera: 8 MP autofocus with flash (Eaton: camera-free version available)
specs.frontCamera: Front camera 1920 x 1080 stills (megapixels not stated; 2 MP in Eaton manual)
specs.ports: 5-pin magnetic charging connector; docking connector (LAN, USB 2.0/3.0, USB-C, HDMI, SD, audio jack); microSDXC and nano-SIM under port cover; VESA 75 x 35 mm mount (Eaton)
specs.docking: Dock DS100M (Aegex) / GEC-ATP-DOST-01 (Eaton), safe area only; shoulder strap; VESA mount
specs.exIp: IP67 in the ATEX marking printed in Eaton's manual (Nemko 25ATEX1018X ... Um = 20V IP67); not in the IECEx database marking for NMK 25.0029X
specs.partNumbers: GZ1A1W51A1A1 (WiFi); GZ1A1G51A1A1 (LTE); carry case GEC-ATP-CC-01; dock GEC-ATP-DOST-01

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based; Eaton lists no scan engine)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (front and rear cameras; a camera-free version is also offered)

unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.
unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Microsoft's end date for Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2024. The maker doesn't state the edition year.
unconfirmed.specs.exIp: From Eaton's manual; the IECEx certificate doesn't state an IP code.
unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: Zone 0 rated when used in the supplied case
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
Camera-free version available for sites that restrict cameras
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
